reason: This is the same shape as the settlement emails I already treat as spam. I look up a named breach on Top Class Actions, not a site called lawsuitai.org that admits its listings are unverified and might start charging later.
objection: How is this not just harvesting the fact that I was in a breach? Free now, paid later, file it yourself, listings not checked — that is a scam pattern, and I have already been burned once.
would_change_my_mind: If I could search my exact breach and it sent me straight to the official claims-administrator site I already recognize, with no account and no email, and it was recommended by a source I already trust — not an AI domain I found on my own.
